content.summary: Exact package and receipt counts support the manuscript's reproducibility numbers. Current snapshot and manuscript hashes match; no integrity discrepancy was found.

checks.method: Rehashed every F01 manifest entry; classified source/configuration paths; counted F29 individual compiler receipts and parsed audit-output records.
checks.observation: All 172 hashes match: 14 new Lean modules, 155 inherited Lean modules, and three toolchain/configuration files. F29 contains 100 inherited and 14 new exit-zero module receipts. Its audit output has exactly 66 distinct passing root records. Both child-summary hashes match the composite receipt. Thus packaged-source count and rebuilt-closure count are distinct, consistent quantities. This checks recorded local evidence, not independent execution or clean external-package rebuilding.
